description: {"time": 1783112232754, "blocks": [{"id": "ef0qqsw7tk", "data": {"text": "Krooks \u2014 an Umo Inner Sacco matatu whose name plays on 'crooks' \u2014 a cheeky acknowledgement of the trickster energy that exists in any transport industry. Umo Inner Sacco serves routes connecting Nairobi's eastern suburbs, and the Krooks design reflects the competitive spirit of those corridors. A name like Krooks suggests a matatu that knows the shortcuts, the loopholes, the ways to get you there faster \u2014 the kind of vehicle every passenger wants to flag down. This reproduction print appeals to those who appreciate the playful dishonesty of good matatu naming.
